newsitem.title: USA: Travelers Group may issue $600 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Travelers Group may issue $600 mln in debt.

text.p: Travelers Group Inc is expected to tap the corporate bond primary market with a two-part $600 million debt offering via underwriter Smith Barney, high-grade syndicate sources said on Wednesday.
The first tranche is expected to consist of $300 million in noncallable 40-year debt. Price talk on the issue is seen in the area of 105 to 110 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, sources said.
The second tranche is expected to consist of $300 million in 40-year debt with a call feature in the tenth year. Price talk on the issue is in the 135 basis point area, sources added.
